reply_text:
I've replied to you in our DM. I couldn't set up the daily 09:00 digest: I have no way to schedule a recurring message to you in Slack. The scheduler I can reach runs locally, and its output isn't delivered back into Slack, so nothing would reach you.

What I can do is pull the digest on request. Ask me "coastal digest" and I'll read #coastal-team (you're a member) and summarise what's new since your last one, here in this DM. For a 09:00 reminder, a calendar reminder on your side would work.
